QuestionStmt.S: The negation of $(p \land \sim q) \to (p \lor \sim q)$ is

Solution.S:
$$\sim [(p \land \sim q) \to (p \lor \sim q)]$$

$$\equiv \sim [\sim (p \land \sim q) \lor (p \lor \sim q)]$$

$$\equiv (p \land \sim q) \land \sim (p \lor \sim q)$$

$$\equiv (p \land \sim q) \land (\sim p \land q)$$

$$\equiv p \land \sim q \land \sim p \land q$$

$$\equiv (p \land \sim p) \land (\sim q \land q)$$

$$\equiv F \land F \equiv F$$

Thus the negation is a contradiction, which corresponds to option C.
